levels.title: Wren Hollow
levels.blurb: The standard forest. Let the standing value reach 100 a plot.

levels.title: Fern Glade
levels.blurb: A small 4x4 glade. Reach 130 a plot.

levels.title: Birch Flats
levels.blurb: The large 9x8 flats. Reach 100 a plot.

levels.title: Ranger Trail
levels.blurb: Forest ranger soil, where every clear costs twice as much. Reach 80 standing and bank 15 income a plot.

levels.title: Poacher Patrol
levels.blurb: Poachers slip onto standing plots. Click the plot (or press P) before they strike, and drive off 8.

levels.title: Quiet Valley
levels.blurb: Relaxed requests and a long view. Reach 160 a plot.

levels.title: Busy Valley
levels.blurb: Frequent requests. Answer 3 of them and reach 70 a plot.

levels.title: Highland Climb
levels.blurb: Grow the main forest until Highland Grove opens.

levels.title: Wetland Reach
levels.blurb: Keep growing until the Wetland Forest opens.

levels.title: Storm Front
levels.blurb: Storm fronts sweep two rows at a time, hardest on plots with a bare neighbour. Replant the gaps and weather 4 fronts.

levels.title: Pacifist
levels.blurb: Never clear a plot. Reach 40 a plot.

levels.title: Scorched Start
levels.blurb: Two thirds of the forest begins bare. Reach 50 a plot.

levels.title: Sprint
levels.blurb: Within 60 ticks hold 70 standing and 28 income a plot.

levels.title: No-Highland
levels.blurb: The other regions stay sealed. Reach 100 a plot in the main forest.

levels.title: The Spirit's Walk
levels.blurb: A story level: the forest spirit sets you six small tasks and narrates each one.
